upload_policy.original_format: PNG preferred for manual art intake
upload_policy.naming_rule: Use the canonical artwork_id exactly as the filename stem.
upload_policy.runtime_rule: Resolve exact media from the art-production/printing ledger identity chain; do not hard-code card names or legacy flat paths in UI.
upload_policy.commit_rule: One image may use its per-card suggested commit message. Multiple images may be uploaded in one batch commit when the client permits it.
